The machine matches: both events in one episode (door_open then key_lost, or key_lost then door_open) lead to rejecting state u3 with the -10 hard-break reward. 'Open the door' sits inside the 'never both' restriction, so it is not an unconditionally commanded goal and the rule-only warning with empty FINAL_STATES is valid. The clause is satisfiable in this environment (e.g., pick up the key, never drop it, open the door).
